filing_office: Connecticut Secretary of the State, Business Services Division
filing_fee_notes: Includes appointment of the statutory agent.
registered_agent_rules: A Connecticut resident may serve, or another business entity registered with the filing office that has a Connecticut address. Individual agents must be at least 18.
expedite_options: Expedited service is available online only; fee and turnaround were not confirmed.
annual_report_due: File each year from January 1 through March 31.
franchise_or_privilege_tax: The former Business Entity Tax was repealed for tax periods beginning after December 31, 2018. This does not establish exemption from other business taxes.
plain_english_summary: File a Certificate of Organization and appoint an agent. File the annual report by March 31.
common_mistake: Treating the annual report as a tax return.
notes: Domestic LLC scope. Name-search URL, standard processing time, publication and operating-agreement requirement were not confirmed and are null. Annual report is an information update, not a financial report.
